上电时序测试 Power-on sequence test													返回
一、测试步骤Test steps
1、配置单板板内的业务转发，使其分别在最大功耗下运行。   
Configure the service forwarding in the single board to operate at the maximum power consumption.
2、设置示波器测试电源输入端的通道为触发通道，触发方式为单次触发，触发沿为上升沿；对所有的在板电源设置各种负载条件下，用硬开关起机，输出电压波形从10%Vo上升到90%Vo的这段时间为输出电压上升时间，如果发现输出波形有振荡等异常情况发生，记录波形。                                                          Set the oscilloscope test power input channel as the trigger channel, the trigger mode is single trigger, and the trigger edge is the rising edge; under various load conditions for all on-board power supplies, start the machine with a hard switch, and the output voltage waveform is from 10%Vo The period of rising to 90%Vo is the output voltage rising time. If an abnormal situation such as oscillation is found in the output waveform, record the waveform.
3、设置示波器测试电源输入端的通道为触发通道，触发方式为单次触发，触发沿为下降沿；对所有的在板电源设置各种负载条件下，用硬开关关机，输出电压波形从90%Vo下降到10%Vo的这段时间为输出电压下降时间，如果发现输出波形有振荡等异常情况发生，记录波形。                                                           Set the oscilloscope test power input channel as the trigger channel, the trigger mode is single trigger, and the trigger edge is the falling edge; under various load conditions for all on-board power supplies, turn off with a hard switch, and the output voltage waveform drops from 90%Vo The period from 10%Vo is the output voltage fall time. If abnormal conditions such as oscillations are found in the output waveform, record the waveform.
4、设置示波器测试电源输入端的通道为触发通道，触发方式为单次触发，触发沿为上升沿；使用多探头分别测试各电源，用硬开关起机，记录各电压的上电时序波形。                                                                                                                                                   Set the oscilloscope test power input channel as the trigger channel, the trigger mode is single trigger, and the trigger edge is the rising edge; use multiple probes to test each power supply separately, start the machine with a hard switch, and record the power-on sequence waveform of each voltage.
5、在步骤2、3、4测试每种情况最少重复5次，结果中取最差值进行记录。                                                                                                                                                                                                    In steps 2, 3, and 4, the test should be repeated at least 5 times in each case, and the worst value of the results will be recorded.
